facts.source_fact: Non-significant monitoring-plan changes must be notified to the regulator by 31 December in the year of the change.
Changing a default factor for a calculation factor can be non-significant where the value is included in the monitoring plan.
Replacing a meter without affecting the tier can be non-significant.
Changing procedure details or description without affecting data accuracy can be non-significant.
The notification is made in METS.
The operator must describe the change.
The operator must state how the change affects monitoring-plan information where appropriate.
The operator must explain how the change accords with the MRR.
A proposed modified plan may be used before approval where the proposed change is not significant.
Even non-significant changes remain subject to regulator notification.
facts.expected_handling: Do not treat non-significant as no-notification.
